rows.text: [Trailblazer], can you see this message? If you do, just {LAYOUT_MOBILE#tap}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#press}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#click} anywhere on the screen —
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Very well. Don't worry. I've temporarily revoked your activity permissions. Let me explain.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Your body is still sitting in the office. This is a Simulated Universe generated from your memories. Now, try to walk around.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Well, at least this isn't fruitless. Your behavior received the Paths' approval. Blessings of Preservation can grant you better protections.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But at least this time you'll have my protection, so there's nothing to worry about. Make your choice.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Use Preservation Blessings to increase your survivability, look for opportunities to improve your combat strength, and have an audience with the Amber Lord again!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Alas, Qlipoth didn't come. I guessed as much — Pick the Blessing that turns Shields into damage, and hurry onward.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I'm going to speed up the process. Now you're going to fight three times in a row. This is not how the Simulated Universe should operate, but I'm running out of patience.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Take the Path of Preservation again, okay? See if we can get Qlipoth to visit once more.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: See? You can move around now. I want you to play Akivili and find some monsters to fight. Let's see which simulated Aeon will notice you first.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: There is a murmur in the amber sky. It's dusk. You look up and find countless copper ore, amber and opal falling from the sky. This is a wondrous mineral rain. In the steam, the colossal thing stretched THEIR spine from the mantle with a sledgehammer gripped in THEIR broad palm. You opened your eyes and realized that this is actually Qlipoth, the Aeon of Preservation!
rows.speaker: Qlipoth

rows.text: Is this a new trick by Herta?
Is this some kind of role-playing?
There is a huge roar around THEM – this is a warning for you. Then, THEY disappear before your eyes.
rows.speaker: Qlipoth

rows.text: "Our calculations are correct. Qlipoth, the Aeon of Preservation, has really appeared." Herta's voice suddenly sounded, and she let out an ambiguous giggle, "The Aeon of Trailblaze, Akivili's revival has attracted an old friend."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But THEY have run away.
Find some monsters to fight. Let's see which simulated Aeon will notice you first.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Mmm, it's going well. Your deeds have been recognized by Qlipoth. The Blessings of Preservation will offer you much better protection.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: On the other hand, you at least have my protection. So you've got nothing to worry about. Come and pick one.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Use Preservation Blessings to increase your survivability, look for opportunities to improve your combat strength, and have an audience with the Amber Lord again!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Alas, Qlipoth didn't come. I guessed as much — Pick the Blessing that turns Shields into damage, and hurry onward.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: [Trailblazer], I'm going to speed up the process. Now you're going to fight three times in a row. This is not how the Simulated Universe should operate, but I'm running out of patience.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Tell me more stories about the relationship between the Aeons!

"What you saw was the simulated Aeon carefully cultivated by Ruan Mei and Screwllum. The simulated Aeons will ignore us just like the real ones, so I set your simulated identity as Akivili, Aeon of Trailblaze, to attract THEM." With a click of her tongue, Herta says, "Now it seems that my judgment is correct. Next time you run into the Aeons, try to get something out of THEM."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Herta?
Go on.
What should I do?
What do you want to know?
You must know more about gossip than I do!
Herta?
Didn't you say it'll only take a second?
"Myths of the Aeons, anecdotes, love stories, the origin of the universe... Anything will do!" Herta was annoyed, "Just think of something!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Be sure to collect Preservation Blessings, okay? See if we can get Qlipoth to visit once more.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Bring it on...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Darn it...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Well, THEY probably won't come.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Sorry, I temporarily revoked your activity permissions — Uh, I need to apologize to you about something.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I confess, I'm a little too eager for success... I won't interfere with the system again. Just play as you like.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "We did it!" Herta yells with excitement, "That was Fuli. THEY thought you were the fallen Akivili, so THEY actively started a conversation with you. Fuli is valuable for our research because THEY have the memories of all beings and know almost as much about everything as {RUBY_B#Aeon of Erudition}Nous{RUBY_E#} does! Come on out, [Trailblazer], I want to upgrade the Simulated Universe. You need to stay in there even longer in the future!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Qlipoth's appearance was probably just a coincidence... That's it. Anyway, I'm sorry.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It feels like a hook pulled at your belly button and your entire body tumbled in a circle. When you open your eyes, you're already back in Herta's office. Your first experience of the Simulated Universe had ended.
The fight is over and you wait in place, but nothing happens.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: There is a long silence, followed by a deep sigh from Herta. "I was expecting THEM to appear. Never mind. I'll switch off the Simulated Universe then. It'll only take a second and you won't feel a thing. Let's chat back in reality."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "THEY... came!" You hear Herta's stunned words. "No, not THEM... It's another Aeon! It's..." Her voice suddenly drifts off. You have a strange feeling about this, as if Herta's words solidified and the whole Simulated Universe became somehow unreal.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You see a blurry figure made of mirror fragments, and THEIR facial features are repeatedly refracted by the prism to form a mystery. Countless memories spring up before your eyes.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: You see Kafka. Her body is stretched, deformed, and rubbed together with the umbrella in her hand, turning into water droplets and falling at your feet.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: You find yourself become a weeping Adlivun baby with an uncut umbilical cord. You remember that there is a golden scar on your body, and golden blood flowing on the dying planet. You find yourself dark-skinned and wearing a robe on the wasteland. You find that you are a swift shadow across the abyss, reaching out to catch the shooting star.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: Then, THEIR voice suddenly came... "...robe flutter wrap travel you expand dark skin you laugh explore thread rotation intertwine coordinate weave ocean vocabulary..." Every word THEY say is connected to each other like a whisper. Before you could say anything, THEY suddenly disappear.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: Wait, let's talk about Kafka.
THEY have controlled my brain!
You said you wouldn't interfere anymore —
Success! I have to tell this news to Stephen right away — [Trailblazer], don't just stand there. Go in and see if you can get a few more words out of them or something...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You should show me some respect.
You have no right to order me around.
Alright, I'll go now then.

In a nutshell, this is a long-scheduled version update with longer gameplay, more content, better rewards, and a more bizarre difficulty curve — so get ready and prepare to get back into the Simulated Universe!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Oh, you're right. I got too excited... Sorry, [Trailblazer]. I do respect you! If you don't mind, could you please go in for another test?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Enemies are falling, and you can't contain your excitement. You are a genius, you are sure of it. Your concentration starts to crumble, you love the shaking of every leaf, you enjoy the destructive power of endless thoughts, until you realize that something is wrong with you — this is not you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Uh oh, THEY're here..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Akivili, Akivili!" A voice laughed wildly, "It has been so long, I miss you greatly!" Your hairs stand on end. This is the infectious enthusiasm of a madman.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: THEY appear before you: Without a head and a mask in THEIR arms. THEY waved THEIR hand at you, still spinning in circles, THEIR arms hanging in midair, THEIR muscles controlling THEIR trembling knuckles, and THEIR posture like that of a sculpture.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "I am so sad." THEY suddenly became sorrowful, "Why did you die?" THEY whimpered in pain, as tears ran down the back of your hand. You felt like you really had died.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "You have fallen too long and the universe has lost its order." THEY began to clap THEIR hands, "Then everything started to turn to chaos! This is what I want! I want to hug you, unfortunately I'm just an equation in a computer. Oh, that seems kinda cool." THEY scratched THEIR head.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "This punk has figured it out again. I have to get Screwllum to edit THEIR data once more..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "I have to apologize to you, really. I lay in ambush aboard your train for a whole year just to blow it up with your Nameless followers. I couldn't resist, I'm sorry." THEY put THEIR hand to the chest guiltily and bowed solemnly.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "This disgrace is still pretending. THEY've already figured out you're not Akivili."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "You're Akivili — you're alive and well, what an interesting opponent! Please play with me more, that's what I want... Grow up and defeat me!" THEY kick the ground with a stomp and fade away... You gasp for air as you escape from the torment.
rows.speaker: Aha

rows.text: "Aha, the Aeon of Elation." Herta explained uncharitably, "A very elusive one who probably found THEMSELF living in a game. This fella is very noisy and dangerous. Next time, bite your tongue and talk to THEM more, thanks for your hard work."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You suddenly fall into a vortex. Looking up, you see THEIR huge body obscuring the sky and the sun. There is a huge, open wound on THEIR torso, from which golden blood flows. You tremble as THEIR eyes glance at you...
rows.speaker: Nanook

rows.text: Immediately, the air suddenly heats up, and the pain hits you hard. You realize that this is the moment of death.
rows.speaker: Nanook

rows.text: What happened?
...Beep ...Beep ...Your consciousness has been cut off... Reconnecting to the Simulated Universe...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "You were disconnected because you just got killed by {RUBY_B#Aeon of Destruction}Nanook{RUBY_E#} in an instant," Herta's voice rang in your ear. "Nanook had never met Akivili before, so it's understandable that THEY don't know you. But I didn't expect THEM to attack you."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You're too unreliable!
It really hurts.
"I know, I just forgot to remind him," Herta said disapprovingly, "Next time I will ask Screwllum to take precautions. Alright, that's all, thanks for your hard work, bye."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You —
You stand in a vast expanse of whiteness and raise your head. You see a tall, valiant figure like a crown prince striding across the Fragmentum.
rows.speaker: Lan

rows.text: The dazzling stellar wind wavered. You see THEM drawing a bow, and then THEY suddenly leap into the distance. You clearly see THEM coming, but after a moment, only his shadow remains.
rows.speaker: Lan

rows.text: "Lan, The Hunt..." Herta whispered. "Don't be in a daze. THEY are ahead of you, hurry up and call THEM."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You find yourself unable to move at all — it's like THEY have nailed you to an invisible wall, and you don't even know when THEY made the move. You struggle, say THEIR name, and...
rows.speaker: Lan

rows.text: It's a turn-based game. You have to deal with me one time before you can go.
Your name is... Lan!
THEY ignore you and, in the blink of an eye, disappear from your sight.
rows.speaker: Lan

rows.text: "Don't be too discouraged. I will increase THEIR social attribute next time." Herta was a little disappointed, "THEY move too fast. But I was able to intercept some of THEIR information."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "THEY're probably not very familiar with Akivili." A moment passed. She added, "Perhaps THEY only have THEIR enemy, the Abundance, on THEIR mind."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The Hunt?
The Abundance?

"A tragic being, according to our record. They are bound by hatred and destiny, never to have even a moment's rest." You don't hear any hint of sympathy for said tragedy in her voice, "But that's life."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Yeah, Yaoshi, the Aeon of Abundance," Herta answers indifferently. "The kindest being in the whole universe, probably also a monster. THEY would heal everything THEY see, be it as small as an atom or as large as a star system. Perhaps THEY can solve your Stellaron problem for you." She adds jokingly.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Look up." Herta says softly, "Someone worth getting excited about has appeared."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You look up and see a figure with six arms wantonly stretch THEIR body and bones, as if performing a cosmic dance.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: THEIR hair is like a magpie's feathers, blooming in a universe of thousands of stars, which reminds you of people's reverie about the Aeons recorded in the book. It's Yaoshi, the Aeon of Abundance.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: "The Trailblaze, I am delighted by your return." THEY stare at you with tens of thousands of eyes on THEIR body, with a voice so sympathetic, as if speaking to you in pity.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: You don't sound happy...
Don't keep staring at me, I'll blush.

"How can a body bounded by its limits cross the boundless oceans? May you give up your burdens, be removed from the cycle of being, and set yourself free from suffering." When THEY finish speaking, THEY kiss you and leave.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: You freeze in place, terrified. THEY stretch out THEIR poisonous scorpion-like hooked tail, and sting you lightly. You see wondrous scenes flashing before your eyes — vines grow wildly and entangle their beneficiaries, and there are abominations and crying everywhere.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: "Are you okay? Talk to me," said Herta with a dissatisfied voice, "well, that's fine. We will meet THEM again."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: For some reason, you are suddenly sucked into darkness. This is a gravitational field where the curvature of space-time expands to its limit, and nothing – neither matter nor light – can escape.
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: You feel yourself being swallowed by some black liquid — a sea of darkness. Your hearing and smell are cut off, and everything becomes far away from you.
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: "Hey! What's going on..." You hear Herta's voice. "There's something wrong with your brainwaves. Hey..."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You stretch out your fingers, but still can't touch the vast, dark sea. You feel like a piece of grease floating on a dark sea of sorrow.
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: "Cheer up, [Trailblazer]. I guess IX, the Aeon of Nihility, has appeared. THEY are nothingness, so the system cannot detect THEIR appearance." Herta says, "Your spirit is affected because IX is near you. You have meaning. You are an amazing person. You are loved and respected. You bring light and a future to our world. Now, keep playing the Simulated Universe. Quickly!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Herta's voice brings your distracted mind back.
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: You only care about your Simulated Universe!
You don't care about me at all!
"Yeah, I forgot." She apologized emotionlessly, "Sorry for making you uncomfortable. Give me a sec. I'll collect some more data on IX, and then I'll get you out right away."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You hold your breath and try to stay focused. You seem to be able to hear toneless syllables deep in the void — it's THEIR voice.
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: You look around and know that THEY are nearby, but cannot see THEIR presence. Maybe, THEY are right next to your ear... Soon, your spirit starts to break...
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: "Stop, [Trailblazer]. You won't be able to hold it anymore." Herta says, "human minds will break when people get near IX, but IX doesn't seem to do it on purpose. Thank you for your hard work, you did a good job!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The strange thing happened again. A chill creeps up your spine, mist clouds your eyes, and you see the familiar vision appearing again.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: This time, THEY are even closer – you can feel THEIR presence and power. Fuli, the Aeon of Remembrance, appears again. THEY float in midair, bowing THEIR head from above. Are THEY looking at you? But you are not sure which section is THEIR eyes.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: You tell yourself to stay sober and complete the mission: Speak to THEM.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: What a coincidence! We meet again.
How did you manage to control my mind?

"...chaos become time your dereliction determine past volume no longer proportional shrink steps one step two steps three feet depart prevent you be warned elio express advance baby fall cancer growing now..." THEY respond to you after hearing what you say. You feel the chill on your face, and the hairs on your skin shudder.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: Then THEY draw away and disappear in an instant. You feel relieved.
rows.speaker: Fuli

rows.text: You hear Herta's voice at just the right time. "You met Fuli again. Well done. Previous testers never even got a response from Fuli." Sounds like she has settled down from her excitement, and her voice has returned to the usual emotionless and mechanical register.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You are still watching me?
Just what did you upgrade?

"Yup, sure am. Just treat it as the perk of being a rookie. Once you're familiar with the Simulated Universe, I won't bother you too much. There's so much to get done, so just play around by yourself."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "What do you think an upgrade is? The next version of a video game? Some tiny rewards handed out every one-and-half-months?" Herta snorts. "This is a whole micro-universe! If you could see all the changes at a glance, why would we spend all the time training a universe? I can just build a garden for your Express instead!"
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Herta sighs. "There's a Downloader just a little further ahead. Remember to use it to expand your team. Your brain is gradually adapting to the Simulated Universe, and the available RAM will gradually become accessible for you so you can play with more people. Alright, snap out of it. Go and choose your Blessing."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Oh, you're right. I got too excited... Sorry, [Trailblazer]. You did very well! If you don't mind, could you please go in for another test?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I've upgraded the Simulated Universe — it now has more memory and can support longer sessions. The last round must've been pretty boring — I'll get Stephen to add a few more interesting things.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: This part was made specifically with you in mind. Ready to have some fun?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Yay! I love fun games!
Not as good as adding more rewards...
I don't trust the definition of "interesting" around here...
Stephen said the same thing. I don't really get "fun," but whatever. What's more important is that the rewards will also increase!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Oh, but we will — after all, you're gonna be spending more time on this project.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What can I say? I don't trust it either. For some reason, whenever someone tells me they're gonna do something interesting, I end up imagining a pile of trash...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: ...so I'd rather talk with you about the added rewards part.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I'll help you out some more. Don't worry.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: An Aeon materializes nearby, and you recognize the familiar sensation. A vortex of energy approaches you and engulfs everything, annihilating every composite atom of your body in the collision. Burning rage and destructive desires tear you into a golden scar that is both your doom and a glimpse from Nanook the Destruction...
rows.speaker: Nanook

rows.text: The pain is over in an instant. You feel like a newborn.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I'm sorry. This is my fault." You hear Herta's voice. "Nanook has never met Akivili. I didn't expect THEM to be so violent even towards an unknown Aeon. You were disintegrated instantly. I had to use system commands to restore a backup of you."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: THEY're the Destruction, after all.
Please warn me next time.

"I know, I know. But if I tell you in advance, there's no way to collect reliable data." Herta says carelessly. "I'll ask Screwllum to protect you in advance. Next time you see the simulated Nanook, you'll give THEM a huge surprise — THEY won't be able to hurt you anymore. Well, that's it then. Great job. I'm gonna hang up."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: You —

A dazzling white light captures your attention. You gaze up into the sky and see a comet streaking across. It is the brightest star you've ever seen, its brilliance as blinding as a dying star's. The comet disappears in a flash, leaving only a spot of residual light on your retina. There is the faint shadow of a person inside the light spot, but you can't really make it out.
rows.speaker: Lan

rows.text: "Lan of The Hunt..." Herta whispers. "THEY noticed you, but... THEY didn't stop for you." After a while, she adds, "Maybe THEY only care about THEIR nemesis, the Abundance."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: The Hunt?
The Abundance?
"A tragic Aeon bound by hatred and destiny, never to have even a moment's rest." You don't hear any hint of sympathy for the said tragedy in her voice. "But that's life."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Yeah, Yaoshi the Abundance," Herta answers indifferently. "The kindest being in the whole universe, probably also a monster. THEY would heal everything THEY see, be it as small as an atom or as large as a star system. Perhaps THEY can solve your Stellaron problem for you." She adds sardonically.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: A gentle sprinkling of light falls from the sky like a soft kiss. Yaoshi the Abundance steps out of thin air. With a smile on THEIR face and compassion knitted into THEIR brows, THEY seem unable to bear seeing you suffer in pain. As THEY walk, thorns sprout up and blossom in THEIR wake.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: "All sentient beings have three deaths — the death of the body, the death of thoughts, and the death of desires." The merciful Aeon whispers. "How can a body bounded by its limits cross the boundless oceans? The Trailblaze, may you give up your burdens, be removed from the cycle of being, and set yourself free from suffering." A thorn slowly floats towards you. Its flowers and leaves bloom before you, and its divine and enlightening nectar falls onto the tip of your tongue.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: Your pain and exhaustion have been swept away...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Yaoshi smiles and THEIR figure recedes into the distance.
rows.speaker: Yaoshi

rows.text: Suddenly, you feel sad. What's this about? Why are you even here? A gigantic machine of consciousness holds your mind hostage and transports you far away into the universe. Everything is false. Truth does not exist. Adventures are meaningless. Tragedy gloats like oil atop a sea of thought, quickly sinking into it to leave behind an enormous void...
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: "Hey! What's going on — " A female voice is speaking. "There's something wrong with your brainwaves. Hey — "
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: That's unimportant. What are brain waves? Not important. You can live without knowing anything, just like a mindless baobab tree. You take in nutrients, grow, then die. Isn't that what life is? A moment of elation, after which there is nothing. Day after day, timeless and unchanging, having no future, having no light...
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: "Ah, I get it."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Yes, abandon all thoughts. Thoughts are burdens of action. Thoughts make you care and make you miserable. The leaves that drift with the current, the dust particles swirling in the wind, the boundless universe, and that black hole — black hole? You seem to realize something. A thought begins to struggle upward, like a drowning human violently beating against the waters. You fight through everything to gasp a breath. Very good. You're finally back. IX was influencing you.
rows.speaker: IX

rows.text: "Very good. You're finally back. IX was influencing you."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: What happened?
IX?

"IX the Nihility appeared. THEY made you feel that everything is meaningless, and you almost became a vegetable in the Simulated Universe — Actually, it won't matter. I could've woken you up in reality. But you might not make it if this happens every time you meet IX." Herta sighs deeply. "This entity is truly nihilistic. THEY made THEMSELF so meaningless that the system didn't even detect THEM. I now believe that IX can destroy the whole universe with just a single thought."
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: "Cheer up, [Trailblazer]. IX's trick won't be so effective next time. You are important, really — Your life is very valuable, and there are many people who love you." She continues emotionlessly. "You have meaning. You are an amazing person. You are loved and respected. You bring light and a future to our world. Now, keep playing the Simulated Universe. Go!"
rows.speaker: Herta
